title: S. Korean envoy reaffirms Seoul's conditional approach to proposed Alaska LNG project
caption:
South Korea’s top envoy reiterated willingness to back the Alaska LNG project, but only under commercial and legal safeguards. No specific investment amount was disclosed, and the country remains open to other U.S. energy partnerships.

Source: En - S. Korean envoy reaffirms Seoul's conditional approach to proposed Alaska LNG project
